name: eggnita-skills
description: Eggnita's shared Claude Code skills, packaged as installable plugins. Every plugin is named egg-{name}.

plugins.name: egg-plane
plugins.description: Manage Plane projects and tasks through the Plane MCP with strict guardrails (resolve IDs, search before create, verify after write, confirm before destroy). Free-tier aware, with epic-simulation, dependency tracking, and a coding-session capture flow.

plugins.name: egg-superposition
plugins.description: Audit and create product, company, or personal positioning and messaging. Scores existing positioning against a distilled pattern library, or generates a positioning brief, section-by-section homepage copy, and a wireframe spec. Includes an adversarial critic + ICP-persona panel that pressure-tests the work, scaled to the stakes.
